description: Source code implementing ONNX preprocessing passes for Torch JIT, including fusion of ListUnpack with other nodes, replacing aten::add with onnx::Concat, and handling list and list unpack operations.

methods.name: FindFusibleListUnpack
methods.description: Finds a node suitable for fusion with ListUnpack based on output usage and kind.

methods.name: FuseWithListUnpack
methods.description: Fuses a node with a ListUnpack node if applicable, adding an attribute for number of outputs and replacing uses.

methods.name: FuseWithListUnpack (Block version)
methods.description: Recursively applies FuseWithListUnpack to all nodes in a block.

methods.name: ReplaceAddWithConcat
methods.description: Replaces aten::add nodes with onnx::Concat when inputs are lists of integers.

methods.name: fuseListAndListUnpack
methods.description: Fuses ListUnpack nodes with preceding nodes when possible, especially when input is a list from other operations.

methods.name: PreprocessForONNX
methods.description: Main function that applies all ONNX preprocessing passes to a graph.
